entries.description: Calibration example for P1: 2.000 s steady tone at f0 = 300 Hz (pitch 0), partials 1/0.15/0.05, 10/30 ms raised-cosine envelope, RMS 7336 LSB (the motif target). Nonsemantic; used for comfort screening, gain calibration and the profile menu.

Calibration example for P2: 2.000 s steady tone at f0 = 450 Hz (pitch 0), partials 1/0.15/0.05, 10/30 ms raised-cosine envelope, RMS 7336 LSB (the motif target). Nonsemantic; used for comfort screening, gain calibration and the profile menu.

Calibration example for P3: 2.000 s steady tone at f0 = 675 Hz (pitch 0), partials 1/0.15/0.05, 10/30 ms raised-cosine envelope, RMS 7336 LSB (the motif target). Nonsemantic; used for comfort screening, gain calibration and the profile menu.

READY cue (familiarization only, never a semantic item): two 120 ms bursts of band-limited noise (about 0.9-2.9 kHz) with 80 ms of silence, 320 ms in total; RMS over the bursts 3668 LSB. Profile-independent.
Grammar click for 'action': one 4 ms click (3 kHz, raised-cosine window, peak 10362 LSB). Profile-independent.
Grammar click for 'target': two 4 ms clicks with onsets 80 ms apart (84 ms in total, peak 10362 LSB). Profile-independent.
Grammar demonstration: action click, exactly 9600 zero samples (200 ms), target click; mirrors action motif, gap, referent motif. Profile-independent.
